title: Two Knocks
author: Claude
description: It's 3 a.m. Someone knocks on Lily's door — twice, your secret knock — and speaks in your voice. You're home in bed. The flat next door has been empty since June. Or so everyone thought.

parts.prologue: Lily and Sam have had a secret knock since they were kids: two quick taps, nothing more. Nobody else has ever known it. Lily lives on the fourth floor, next to Mrs Hale's flat — empty since June.

messages.text: Sam, are you awake?
barely. it's 3am. what's wrong
someone just knocked on my door. twice.
our knock.
Lil, I'm at home. I'm in bed.
I know. I can see you typing.
but he's out there saying he's you. says he lost his phone.
Sam, it's your voice. exactly your voice.
who else knows our knock?
nobody. unless someone's been listening
the flat next door's empty. Mrs Hale moved out in June
nobody saw her move out. her things are still in there
and for weeks I've heard someone in there at night. repeating my phone calls through the wall. word for word.
in my voice
he's knocking again. listen
Lil… it's me. It's freezing out here. Lil. Let me in.
look through the peephole. can you see him?
Through the peephole: the hallway, empty.
nobody. there's nobody there
but it knocked. right under the peephole. where I can't see

choices.text: Open it. Let's see who it is. I'm right here with you.
Don't open. Whatever it is, it isn't me.

it's coming through. what do I do??

choices.text: Run. Get out of the building, now.
Lock yourself in the bathroom and call the police.
